def _attachment(filename: str) -> dict:
    """Content-Disposition that survives any visitor id (Hebrew letters, quotes, slashes).

    HTTP headers carry latin-1 only, so the plain name is an ASCII fallback and the real
    name goes in filename* (RFC 5987), which browsers use when present.
    """
    ascii_name = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9._-]+", "_", filename) or "report.xlsx"
    return {
        "Content-Disposition": "attachment; filename=\"{}\"; filename*=UTF-8''{}".format(
            ascii_name, quote(filename, safe="")
        )
    }
